findings.title: Worker-editable .git/config hard link overwrites a file outside configured roots
findings.reproduction: In a disposable fixture clone, replace .git/config with a hard link to a regular file outside every configured root, then call artifacts.freeze. The adapter accepted the workspace and overwrote the external file with the fixed Git config; the link count remained 2.
findings.impact: The freeze path performs an arbitrary write to any same-filesystem file the worker can hard-link, despite validating the config path itself. The regular-file check must also reject hard links before opening with O_TRUNC.
findings.evidence: Independent temporary-repository probe; no development repository was used as a runtime target.

limits: All local deliveries and security probes used disposable temporary Git repositories. They are fixtures, not proof of a live product/runtime integration or provider behavior.
No provider/model call, B2 operation, authentication change, external write, or source edit was performed.
